## About
Lynwood Auto Dismantling is a salvage yard on S. Alameda Street in Lynwood. We specialize in European car parts and carry parts from BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Volkswagen, Audi, Saab, Jaguar and Volvo, along with late model domestic parts.
We're part of a large network of salvage yards across the country, which helps us find the right part for you. Whether you're a car owner, a collision or auto repair shop, or a dealership, give us a call and one of our salespeople will help.
Customers rate us 4 stars across 94 Google reviews.

## Services
- European car parts: Parts for European makes, including BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Volkswagen, Audi, Saab, Jaguar and Volvo.
- Free parts locating: As part of a nationwide network of salvage yards, we can help locate the part you need.
- Cars for sale: We have cars for sale on our lot.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of parts do you carry?
A: We specialize in European car parts from makers like BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Volkswagen, Audi, Saab, Jaguar and Volvo, and we also carry late model domestic parts.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're on S. Alameda Street in Lynwood, on the east side of the train tracks, at the corner of S. Alameda and Santa Ana Blvd/Fernwood Ave. Call us if you'd like more detailed directions.

Q: How can I pay?
A: We accept PayPal, Visa, Mastercard, American Express and Discover, as well as debit cards, bank drafts and eChecks.
